text: Cymidei Cymeinfoll is a Welsh giantess and a heroine on record. She wed the giant Llassar. The pair owned a cauldron that could restore the dead. That vessel sets in much of the action found in branch two of the Mabinogi. She brings forth a host of armed legions, whelping a fresh set each pass of six or seven weeks. Her translated title names a fighter born of a fine bough. MacKillop heads the entry with the alias Kymideu Kymeinvoll. He paints her as a giantess of the Branwen story, the second branch of the Mabinogi. She stands twice the size of her husband. Matholwch meets the couple hauling the cauldron of regeneration. Their children show disorders, so he plans to burn the pair inside an iron house. The two flee to Britain and hand Bran their cauldron in thanks for the welcome. A prophecy says she will bear a warrior armed from birth. Proinsias Mac Cana reads her as the Celtic goddess doubled, holding fertility and warlike force at once.
